name: Kdenlive
summary: A free and open-source video editor for Linux, Windows, macOS and BSD.
description: Kdenlive is a free and open-source desktop video editor from the KDE community. It covers the core editing workflow (organising footage, editing on a multi-track timeline, adding effects, transitions and titles, and exporting) and has an official user manual with a quick-start section. It runs on Linux, Windows, macOS and BSD, which makes it one of the few full editors with strong Linux support.

pricing.free_tier_details: Free and open source, as stated on the official site.

key_capabilities.text: Free and open-source video editing on Linux, Windows, macOS and BSD.
Official manual covers project and asset management, editing, effects and filters, transitions, titles and exporting.

limitations.text: Desktop only: no web or mobile version is listed on the official site.

best_for: Linux users who want a full video editor
not_ideal_for: Editing on a phone or tablet
getting_started: Download Kdenlive from the official site.
Follow the 'Quick Start' section of the official manual.
Export a short test clip before starting a longer project.
